result.brief: 提出 Δ-flow：以近期历史加轻噪声构造流匹配源分布，替代固定高斯先验，使机器人 VLA 与世界动作模型（含未来视觉分支）可用单步推理并提升训练效率与泛化。
result.reason: Proposes history-conditioned flow-matching source for robot VLA/world-action models, including visual future-state generation; a generative-recipe contribution to world-action models rather than pure policy.
